description: This file defines a repository module for managing 'tags' in a database using SQLAlchemy. It provides asynchronous functions to create, update, delete, retrieve, and list tags, including error handling for conflicts and not found scenarios.

classes.name: TagRow
classes.description: Immutable dataclass representing a tag record with id, name, and creation timestamp.

methods.name: TagRow create_tag(session: AsyncSession, *, name: str)
methods.description: Creates a new tag in the database, raises ConflictError if the tag name already exists.

methods.name: TagRow update_tag(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID, name: str)
methods.description: Updates the name of an existing tag identified by tag_id, raises NotFoundError if not found and ConflictError if the new name conflicts.

methods.name: None delete_tag(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Deletes a tag by its ID, raises NotFoundError if the tag does not exist.

methods.name: TagRow get_tag(session: AsyncSession, *, tag_id: UUID)
methods.description: Fetches a tag by its ID, raises NotFoundError if not found.

methods.name: tuple[list[TagRow],int] list_tags(session: AsyncSession, *, q: str | None, limit: int, offset: int)
methods.description: Lists tags with optional search query, returns a list of TagRow and total count.
